name: The Fairmont Jasper Park Lodge
positioning: Fairmont Jasper Park Lodge is a lakeside mountain resort with cabins, suites and rooms in Jasper National Park
best_for: Travelers who want a cabin-style stay in the Rocky Mountains
Golfers who want a Stanley Thompson-designed course
Families wanting suites or cabins with extra living space

facts.text: The hotel is set on a 700-acre resort in the Rocky Mountains.
The setting is between peaks, pine forests and Lac Beauvert, and the property offers rooms, suites and Signature Cabins.
The hotel rooms are chalet-style, with Rocky Mountain or Lac Beauvert views, in Alberta's Jasper National Park.
The resort has an 18-hole golf course designed by Stanley Thompson.
The Marmot Basin ski area is 20km from the hotel.
The One Bedroom Suite Bayview is along the lake and has bunk beds and a private furnished patio, described as ideal for families.
The Ridgeline three-bedroom cabin has a gas fireplace, kitchen, patio and washer-dryer.
The Junior Suite Wood Stove rooms are in Crosby Cabin, with a separate living area, a double sofabed and cabin or woodland views.

highlights.text: The resort has an 18-hole golf course designed by Stanley Thompson.
The Viewpoint three-bedroom cabin has a kitchen, games room, sauna and enclosed veranda.
The Luxury Lakefront one-bedroom suites sit along the 18th fairway of the golf course and have a wood fireplace.
The Athabasca Cabin has wooded resort views and an ensuite bathroom with a soaker tub, and is described as ideal for couples.
The Deluxe Main Lodge King rooms are on the second floor of the Main Lodge and have a private balcony with views of Lac Beauvert.

considerations.text: The Fairmont Main Lodge King rooms are on the first floor of the Main Lodge and have limited views of Lac Beauvert.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires planning for dining and activities.
WhataHotel notes limited winter operations at this seasonal property.
